transcript.speaker: Peter Hale
transcript.text: Thanks for making time, Dana. I've got us down for 30 minutes: I'd like to understand where Northwind is today, then share how we might help.

transcript.speaker: Dana Price
transcript.text: Sounds good. Online sales flattened this year and the board wants a plan before Q3.

transcript.speaker: Peter Hale
transcript.text: What have you tried so far, and how did it go?

transcript.speaker: Dana Price
transcript.text: We had an agency last year. Honestly, they were expensive and we never saw the numbers move.

transcript.speaker: Peter Hale
transcript.text: That's fair. When Harbour Health came to us they'd been burned the same way; we tied our fee to repeat orders and they grew 22% in two quarters.

transcript.speaker: Dana Price
transcript.text: That's interesting. What would a first project with you look like, and when could you start?

transcript.speaker: Peter Hale
transcript.text: Let's book a 45-minute workshop next Tuesday with your ecommerce lead, and I'll bring a draft plan.

transcript.speaker: Dana Price
transcript.text: Tuesday works. I'll send the invite.
